items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.6(b), cost of establishing cause and extent, capped at EUR 3,000. The price follows the prior (~524) and the case 20 reference (>=481).
Leak location is covered under 5.2.6(a). Together with the technician time on line 3 it shares the EUR 1,000 cap, which these two lines stay just under. Price is in line with case 20 (>=707).
The on-site time of the leak-location technician is expressly included in 5.2.6(a) and falls within the shared EUR 1,000 cap with line 2. Estimate is 2.5 h at about EUR 80/h.
5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge per contractor per invoice, up to EUR 70 net, which is about EUR 83.30 gross.

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, leakage from porosity or ageing counts as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking. Two weeping joints were sealed, so this repair is covered at a customary price.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: 2.4.3 states that sections not shown to be leaking are not covered. 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a) also exclude work on unaffected parts and preventive upkeep.
7.1.9 bars improvement over the pre-loss standard, so the upgrade difference is borne by the policyholder.
5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge per contractor per invoice, including for the repair journey, capped at EUR 70 net, about EUR 83.30 gross.
